name: PeterK IconLib
notes: Build 582 uses the OS 3.2-compatible icon.library 51.4.582 (TC020). The stock library and its build-582 IconLib.guide use checked BCWB payload files while the exact upstream archive is unresolved.
The BCWB distribution installer renames the AmigaOS original to Libs/icon.library.bak. That file comes from the target OS, and the shared system startup files and drawers are outside this package.
